question: A mentorship programme to train young authors named 'Young, Upcoming and Versatile Authors' (YUVA) scheme was launched in June 2021. Under the mentorship scheme, a consolidated scholarship of ____________ per month was proposed to be paid for a period of six months per author.
solution:
The correct answer is** __50,000__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A mentorship programme to train young authors named the 'Young, Upcoming and Versatile Authors' (YUVA) scheme was launched in June 2021.
 
• Under the mentorship scheme, a consolidated scholarship of **₹50,000 per month** was proposed to be paid for a period of six months per author.
 
• The central government has launched the scheme in honour of the country's 75 years of Independence. 
 
• Thereby, creating future leaders of tomorrow.
 
• The scheme for Young Upcoming Versatile Authors abbreviates into YUVA. 
 
• It is a PM Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​To help youngster achieve their business dreams,** The Union Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship **under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched Pradhan Mantri Yuva Yojana (PMYY).
 
• The aim of the scheme is to provide training to 75 aspiring writers below 30 years. 
 
• These authors should be ready to express themselves and project India along with its culture and literature globally.
